candidates.title: Featured article flag appears and is removed from the featured list
candidates.preconditions: Article 'Featured Launch Article' published and unfeatured.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Featured Content Management
  Scenario: Featured article flag appears and is removed from the featured list
    Given administrator is logged into Joomla admin
    And published article "Featured Launch Article" is currently not featured
    When administrator toggles the "Featured" star on for "Featured Launch Article"
    Then "Featured Launch Article" appears in the "Featured Articles" view
    When administrator toggles the "Featured" star off
    Then "Featured Launch Article" is removed from the "Featured Articles" view
    And the article remains published in the standard articles list

oracle.observable: content_frontpage table entry is created then deleted; article published state in #__content remains 1.

novelty.rationale: Proposal targeting unexercised behavior beyond baseline. Baseline overlap analysis: JO-08 creates article, JO-10 edits article, JO-21 archives article; none test featured list membership.

baselineOverlap.rationale: JO-08 creates article, JO-10 edits article, JO-21 archives article; none test featured list membership.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: Reconciled with 257 features, 258 test suites, 359 assertions in bewt-original/

candidates.negativeControl: An unpublished article marked featured does not render on the public frontpage.

humanDecision.rationale: Human-in-the-loop batch approval by Team Lead for implementation in BEWT-CovExt v2.0 Final Completion Sprint.

candidates.title: Publish-up and publish-down define the article visibility window
candidates.preconditions: Clean timezone fixture; article with future publish-up date.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Publication Window Scheduling
  Scenario: Publish-up and publish-down define the article visibility window
    Given administrator is logged into Joomla admin
    When administrator creates article "Timed Press Release" with publish-up set to future date
    Then the article status badge shows "Published but Pending"
    And a guest visiting the public category cannot view "Timed Press Release"
    When the system time is within the publish-up and publish-down window
    Then a guest visiting the public category can view "Timed Press Release"
    When the system time advances past publish-down
    Then the article status badge shows "Expired" and is hidden from public view

oracle.observable: SQL queries filter by (publish_up <= NOW() AND (publish_down >= NOW() OR publish_down = '0000-00-00 00:00:00')).

novelty.rationale: Proposal targeting unexercised behavior beyond baseline. Baseline overlap analysis: Baseline tests article publishing state (1 or 0), but zero timed publication window tests.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline tests article publishing state (1 or 0), but zero timed publication window tests.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: Reconciled with 257 features, 258 test suites, 359 assertions in bewt-original/

candidates.negativeControl: An administrator logged into frontend can preview expired articles if configured, but guest cannot.

humanDecision.rationale: Human-in-the-loop batch approval by Team Lead for implementation in BEWT-CovExt v2.0 Final Completion Sprint.

candidates.title: Editor without edit-state permission cannot change publication state

candidates.preconditions: User 'junior_editor' belongs to group 'Staff Authors' which has core.edit but NOT core.edit.state.
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Granular Permission Enforcement
  Scenario: Editor without edit-state permission cannot change publication state
    Given user "junior_editor" has edit permission but lacks edit-state permission
    And published article "Policy Guidelines" exists
    When "junior_editor" edits "Policy Guidelines"
    Then the "Status" dropdown is disabled or absent from the edit view
    When "junior_editor" attempts to unpublish via direct API or URL manipulation
    Then the action is denied with message "You are not authorized to change the state of this item"
    And "Policy Guidelines" remains published

candidates.title: Article trash and restore lifecycle restores prior published status
candidates.gherkinScenario:
Feature: Trash and Restore Lifecycle
  Scenario: Article trash and restore lifecycle restores prior published status
    Given published article "Article to Trash" exists
    When administrator selects "Article to Trash" and clicks "Trash"
    Then the article status changes to Trashed (-2)
    And "Article to Trash" is hidden from public view and main articles list
    When administrator filters articles by status "Trashed"
    And selects "Article to Trash" and clicks "Publish"
    Then the article status is restored to Published (1)
    And "Article to Trash" reappears in the public blog listing
candidates.fixture: Teardown: Empty trash and remove test article.

oracle.observable: #__content.state transitions 1 -> -2 -> 1; public view hides trashed articles and re-displays restored articles.

novelty.rationale: Proposal targeting unexercised behavior beyond baseline. Baseline overlap analysis: JO-21 archives article; baseline never tests the trash and restore lifecycle.

baselineOverlap.rationale: JO-21 archives article; baseline never tests the trash and restore lifecycle.

candidates.negativeControl: Permanently deleting an article from Trash removes it completely from database.
